jobs.occupation: Project Manager - International Industrial Technology Group
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international industrial technology group providing engineered solutions that improve workplace safety, environmental performance and production efficiency. As Project Manager, you will oversee industrial installation projects from order confirmation through commissioning, coordinating customers, subcontractors and internal teams to ensure successful delivery.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage industrial projects from order confirmation to final handover
• Act as the main point of contact for customers throughout execution
• Review purchase orders and contractual requirements
• Coordinate subcontractors, installers and internal stakeholders
• Plan resources, schedules and site activities
• Monitor budgets, milestones, risks and project profitability
• Negotiate scope changes and contractual deviations
• Ensure accurate reporting, documentation and customer acceptance

• Master's or Bachelor's degree in Electromechanics, Electrical Engineering or similar
• Minimum 7 years of project management experience in a technical or industrial environment
• Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously
• Strong understanding of industrial installations, equipment or infrastructure projects
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
• Comfortable handling contractual, financial and administrative follow-up
• Ability to read technical drawings and interact with engineering teams
• CAD knowledge is a strong asset
• Fluent French and Dutch with good English
• Solution-oriented, autonomous and assertive personality

Our client is a leading player in the packaging and industrial solutions sector, recognized for its innovation, operational excellence and commitment to sustainable manufacturing.With a strong footprint across Europe and ambitious growth plans, the company is looking to strengthen its commercial presence within the DACH region (Germany, Austria & Switzerland) through the recruitment of a highly driven Business Development Manager.This opportunity is ideally suited to a true sales developer, someone who enjoys identifying opportunities, opening new doors and driving market expansion rather than simply managing existing relationships.

Jobomschrijving

• Develop and execute a commercial growth strategy for the DACH region.
• Identify, prospect and convert new customers across targeted industrial sectors.
• Build and maintain a robust sales pipeline.
• Develop long-term relationships with key decision-makers.
• Understand customer needs and propose tailored technical solutions.
• Lead negotiations and successfully close commercial agreements.
• Collaborate closely with internal technical, operational and customer service teams.
• Represent the company at trade fairs, industry events and customer meetings.
• Monitor competitor activity and market trends.
• Maintain accurate forecasting and CRM reporting.

We are looking for a real business developper.The successful candidate will demonstrate:

• Proven experience in Business Development, Technical Sales or B2B Commercial Development.
• A genuine passion for acquiring new customers and opening new markets.
• Strong prospecting, networking and relationship-building skills.
• An entrepreneurial mindset with a high degree of autonomy.
• Excellent communication and negotiation abilities.
• The resilience and determination required to develop business within a competitive market.
Experience within packaging, manufacturing, industrial products, paper, printing, labels, plastics or other technical environments is considered a strong advantage.German is the key success factor for this role.Given the strategic focus on the DACH region, candidates must possess:

• Perfect proficiency in German
• Professional French and/or English
• Additional languages are an asset
You must be capable of conducting negotiations, presentations and commercial discussions at senior decision-maker level entirely in German.

Our client is a specialized consultancy company with a unique market position, having worked exclusively with the same international aviation industry leader for more than 15 years. This long-term partnership offers an exceptional combination of stability, expertise, and continuous technological evolution.Operating within a highly international environment, the company supports business-critical data and analytics initiatives that enable strategic and operational decision-making across multiple regions and business functions. Thanks to its close relationship with its client, employees benefit from the scale, complexity, and career opportunities of a large multinational organization while enjoying the agility, accessibility, and human-sized culture of a smaller consultancy structure.

Jobomschrijving

As a Data Engineer / BI Consultant, you will contribute to the design, development, maintenance, and optimization of the organization's data ecosystem.Your responsibilities will include:

• Developing, maintaining, and optimizing data pipelines within a Snowflake environment.
• Working with SQL and Linux/Bash to support data integration, automation, and transformation processes.
• Implementing and maintaining solutions within a modern Data Mesh architecture combining Data Lake and Data Warehouse principles.
• Ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of data flows and reporting solutions.
• Collaborating closely with international business stakeholders located across multiple countries and time zones.
• Gathering business requirements and translating them into sustainable and efficient data solutions.
• Supporting the continuous improvement of reporting, analytics, and Business Intelligence capabilities.
• Contributing to data quality, governance, and optimization initiatives.
• Participating in ongoing projects related to cloud data platforms and digital transformation.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with excellent communication skills and enjoys working in an international environment.We are looking for someone who can demonstrate:

• 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing, or a similar domain.
• Hands-on experience with Snowflake at an intermediate level.
• Strong knowledge of:
• SQL
• Linux/Bash
• Data Factory
• Experience working with business stakeholders and translating functional requirements into technical solutions.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with international teams.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
The following skills would be considered an advantage:

• Experience with Data Mesh architectures.
• Knowledge of Power BI.
• Experience with Matillion.
• Experience with Teradata.
Languages:

• English is mandatory.
• French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets.

Are you ready for a new challenge where your expertise can truly make a difference?
 

If you have a Scientific degree and experience in Pharma, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or related field, this is your opportunity to be part of something bigger than yourself. As an Operations Expert, you'll play a key role in manufacturing advanced cell therapies that are transforming cancer treatment and giving patients new hope.
 

Every day, your work will directly contribute to delivering life-changing therapies to patients facing serious diseases. Join a passionate team united by a shared purpose: creating innovative treatments and improving lives around the world.
 

Your key responsibilities:
 

 
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.
 
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.
 
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.
 
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.
 
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste. 

Who we are looking for:
 

 
• You have obtained at least a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.
 
• Cell experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 
 
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.
 
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.
 
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
 
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.
 
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

You will work with modern technologies in an innovative and sustainable environment and contribute to the company's success.

 
• 
You have technical insight and, preferably, prior experience as an operator.

You will work in a robotized environment, operate machines, and check the quality of the final product.

You can communicate fluently in Dutch or English.

 
•

As a Freight Forwarder export, you are responsible for coordinating and monitoring domestic and international shipments and serve as the point of contact for customers, carriers, and internal stakeholders.
 

Your main responsibilities:
 
 
 
• Organizing and coordinating shipments by road, rail, sea, and air 
 
• Operational monitoring of shipments (including sailings, railcars, and HSE) 
 
• Preparing and processing transport and shipping documents (including Bill of Lading, Letter of Instruction, Dispatch...) 
 
• Receiving and processing customs documents 
 
• Managing and updating transportation information and procedures (including in SharePoint) 
 
• Preparing and sending container and cargo manifests 
 
• Informing customers about costs, transit times, and shipment status 
 
• Ensuring accurate record-keeping and a smooth handoff within the team 

Who are you?
 
 
 
• Minimum A2 diploma  
 
• Minimum 2–5 years of relevant experience as a freight forwarder export or in a similar role 
 
• Strong operational knowledge of freight forwarding and logistics processes 
 
• Knowledge of transport documentation and IT systems 
 
• An IMDG certificate (dangerous goods) is a strong asset 
 
• Fluent in Dutch and English, both verbally and in writing 
 
• Meticulous, able to handle stress, customer-focused, and a strong communicator 
 
• Able to work independently and manage priorities

For a leading international player we are looking for a 
Financial Controller ready to make an impact in a fast-paced and growing environment.
 

In this role, you act as a key link between finance and operations. You analyze financial performance, monitor the balance sheet, and provide clear insights and recommendations to management. You will also play an active role in improving processes and profitability.
 

Your responsibilities
 
 

• Analyze and report on financial performance 

• Act as a business partner for management and international stakeholders 

• Prepare budgets and forecasts 

• Identify and monitor financial risks 

• Drive process improvements and profitability initiatives 
 

• Minimum 3years experience in controlling, finance, or consultancy 

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance or related field 

• Strong analytical and communication skills 

• Solid Excel skills; SAP is a plus 

• Fluent in English 

• Based in Belgium and in possession of a valid work permit

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English, spoken and written.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

Do you enjoy precision shaping pipes and creating strong welds for technical installations? As a TIG or semi-automatic welder, you'll work on a variety of HVAC projects within the construction sector. You'll read plans, build custom installations, and weld pipes into perfect assemblies for heating and plumbing. Depending on the project, you'll work both on-site and in the workshop, preparing and assembling components. Thanks to the variety of high-end projects, your job remains technically challenging and educational. You'll be part of a large team where collaboration, quality, and safety are paramount.

What are your tasks?

• Reading and interpreting technical plans
• Bending, grinding, and welding pipes (TIG/semi-automatic)
• Preparing and assembling installations in the workshop and on-site

• Experience as a welder in a technical or construction environment
• Communicate in English or Romanian
• Possession of a driver's license

Their rental branch offers premium solutions featuring next-generation heavy equipment and comprehensive services across the region.
 

To support their continuous growth, iRecruit has been exclusively mandated to find a 
Rental Manager Belgium to lead and strengthen their activities. If you’re looking for your next career move in a dynamic environment, this could be the perfect opportunity. Apply today!
 

As the Rental Manager Belgium, you are responsible for the overall management and commercial development of the rental activities across the country. jobs.occupation: Office & Facility Administrative Assistant - Part Time 3/5th
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an new opportunity within administration and facility coordination? You will be a key support to the team, ensuring smooth daily operations. You'll manage service requests, provide high‑quality administrative assistance, and service to internal stakeholders. This role is ideal for a highly organised, proactive professional who thrives in a dynamic environment fluent in English and French or Dutch.

 

Client Details

Our client is a leading international company active in life sciences sector, known for its strong focus on innovation, research, and high‑quality standards. With a collaborative culture and a commitment to employee well‑being, they offer a dynamic work environment where people can grow, contribute, and make a real impact. The company is located at the border of Brussels/Zaventem and easily accessible by public transport from Brussels and surroundings.

Description

As Office/Facility & Administrative Coordinator you'll:

• Act as first contact for all facilities questions and service requests.
• Keep documents, records, and vendor information organised and up to date.
• Manage ticketing system by assigning requests and ensuring timely follow‑up.
• Coordinate small office moves, furniture needs, and daily workplace logistics.
• Help organise supplier visits, meetings, and on‑site interventions.
• Support QHSE activities by maintaining safety documentation and assisting with inspections.

• Fluent in English and French or Dutch
• Previous experience in administrative support, office management, or facilities coordination.
• Strong organisational, communication, and interpersonal skills with a customer‑focused, solution‑oriented mindset.
• Ability to work independently with high attention to detail and confidence using MS Office.
• Comfortable coordinating with multiple stakeholders in a dynamic environment.

• Develop new business opportunities and grow an existing client portfolio
• Advise clients on recruitment strategies and market trends
• Manage the recruitment process from briefing to offer stage
• Negotiate offers and ensure a smooth hiring process
• Maintain accurate candidate and client records

• Bachelor's or Master's degree

• Strong commercial drive and entrepreneurial mindset
• Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
• Resilient, results-oriented, and proactive
• Able to work independently while thriving in a team environment
• Interested in sales, recruitment, and people management

jobs.occupation: Business Development Manager Industial & Technical Solutions
jobs.description:
HQ Antwerp | Coverage: Europe (with potential EMEA expansion)| Business Development Manager| Energy, Oil & Gas

About the Company
Our client is an international technology organization with a strong footprint across Europe. The company designs and delivers advanced software and hardware solutions for complex industrial environments in the oil & gas industry, helping customers operate safely, efficiently and in full regulatory compliance.
 

Your New Role 
As Business Development Manager, you are responsible for driving new business growth across Europe. You focus on opening new doors, building long-term commercial relationships and developing a sustainable opportunity pipeline within large, complex organizations. This is a pure new business role with a long-term perspective. You will work on strategic target accounts with lengthy investment cycles, where success depends on trust-building, market insight, and persistence rather than short-term wins. You work closely with the Sales Manager and internal technical teams and operate in a hybrid model combining office-based work, customer visits and international travel. Key Responsibilities
• Identify, approach and develop new customers and new opportunities across European markets
• Map target regions, industries and strategic accounts and define focused action plans
• Establish relationships with key decision-makers within complex organizations
• Build and manage a qualitative sales pipeline through continuous prospecting and follow-up
• Understand customer processes, strategic challenges and long-term investment roadmaps
• Prepare and deliver tailored presentations, demonstrations and commercial proposals
• Collaborate with internal engineering and solution teams to translate business needs into technical solutions
• Represent the organization at customer meetings, industry events and conferences
• Maintain structured reporting and pipeline management through CRM tools
• Contribute to long-term growth strategy, forecasting and market development initiatives
 

Your Profile

• At least 3 years of experience in Business Development within a technical or industrial environment
• Educational background in engineering, industrial technology or IT, or equivalent technical-commercial experience
• Experience or affinity with industries such as energy, process industry, industrial systems or infrastructure is a plus
• Demonstrated ability to generate new business, open new accounts and build relationships from the ground up
• Strong hunter mentality with resilience and confidence in approaching senior stakeholders
• Comfortable operating in environments with long sales cycles and high-value investment projects
• Strong communication and presentation skills at executive and technical levels
• Languages: English and Dutch are mandatory; additional European languages (German or French) German is a plusWillingness to travel regularly (short, project-based trips)

jobs.occupation: Receptionist - International Law Firm - Centre Brussels
jobs.description:
As a Receptionist, you will support the smooth day-to-day operations of an international law firm. You will combine front-desk responsibilities with administrative support, coordinate various office-related activities, and help ensure a professional experience for colleagues, visitors and business partners in a multicultural environment.

 

Client Details

Our client is a well-established international law firm. With a strong reputation for excellence and a collaborative, multicultural environment, fostering a supportive and people-oriented workplace. There are located next to a metro and bus station and at walking distance from a train station.

 

Description

As a Receptionist you'll be responsible for:

• Manage the reception area and ensure a professional and welcoming experience for visitors.
• Answer and direct incoming phone calls.
• Coordinate meeting rooms, including scheduling, room setup, and catering arrangements.
• Oversee office supplies and maintain stock levels.
• Handle incoming and outgoing mail, and deliveries.
• Provide administrative support for document management, invoicing, and office-related processes.
• Support the wider office team with ad hoc administrative tasks and projects.

• First professional experience in reception, hospitality, customer service or administration is a plus.
• Excellent communication skills with a strong service-oriented mindset.
• Proactive, reliable and solution-oriented.
• Ability to multitask and remain organised in a fast-paced environment.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word and Excel).
• Excellent spoken and written English and French; Dutch is a plus.
